_comment: Capitals: the ten towns on the map (data/settlements.json), written into server/world/world.json by scripts/tools/export_server_world.gd. A faction's capital town (factions.json `capital`) is level 2, every other town level 1. A town guard (`guard` soldiers: base * growth^(level - 1), mixed as `guard_armies`) holds each one behind strong walls (palisade_base + palisade_per_level * (level - 1)) until someone beats them. Whoever takes a town gets `yields` (per hour, base * yield_growth^(level - 1), stored up to store_hours) and every castle of the holder's alliance (online; only the holder offline) produces `bonus` more of everything: bonus_base + bonus_per_level * (level - 1) per capital, at most max_bonus in all. Your keep must reach min_keep to take one; a player holds at most per_player capitals and an alliance at most per_alliance. A capital just taken can't be attacked for peace_hours.
_buildings: Town buildings: whoever holds a capital builds them there, paid from their home castle, one at a time; level n costs cost * cost_growth^(n - 1) and takes time * time_growth^(n - 1) seconds, and nothing can hurry it. They belong to the town: they stay when it changes hands or is given up, but one still being built is lost. walls: + defense to its walls per level, for whoever defends it. market: it sends yield_bonus more gold per level. guardhouse: `guards` soldiers per level (the town guard's mix) fight beside its holder's guards, back in full after every battle. guildhall: every castle of the holder's alliance produces `production` more per level, on top of the capitals' bonus, at most guild_max from all guild halls together.

walls.name: Town Walls
walls.description: Stone walls and towers around the town. Its defenders fight harder behind them, whoever holds it.

market.name: Market
market.description: Merchants and stalls on the square. The town sends its holder more gold every hour.

guardhouse.name: Guardhouse
guardhouse.description: The townsfolk keep a watch of their own. It fights beside the guards its holder stations there and is back in full after every battle.

guildhall.name: Guild Hall
guildhall.description: The town's guilds work for the whole alliance. Every castle of the holder's alliance produces more, on top of what the capitals give.
